cat > FilterUITests/FilterUITests.swift <<'EOF'
import XCTest

final class FilterUITests: XCTestCase {
    func testFilterRoomsForBook() {
        let app = XCUIApplication(bundleIdentifier: "im.vector.app")
        app.activate()
        sleep(2)
        var search = app.searchFields.firstMatch
        if !search.waitForExistence(timeout: 5) {
            search = app.textFields.firstMatch
        }
        if search.exists {
            search.tap()
        } else {
            app.coordinate(withNormalizedOffset: CGVector(dx: 0.5, dy: 0.2)).tap()
        }
        sleep(1)
        app.typeText("Book")
        sleep(2)
    }
}
EOF
